title: App not showing up in Play Store on Wear OS watch
symptom: The xDrip+ app is not showing up in the Play Store on the Wear OS watch under 'Apps on your phone', preventing installation via the watch.
fix: The issue was resolved by using the 'Wear Install' third-party app, as mentioned in the comment by erizzo.
evidence_quote: #1648 is indeed the same problem I was experiencing. The Wear Install third-party app solved it for me.
